name: Lake Manyara National Park
tagline: Tree-climbing lions, flamingos and groundwater forest
intro: Compact and varied, Lake Manyara packs groundwater forest, open grassland and a shimmering soda lake beneath the Rift Valley escarpment into a single day of game driving.
It is known for its tree-climbing lions and for large flocks of flamingos when conditions suit.
bestTime: June to October for wildlife; November to June for birdlife.
metaTitle: Lake Manyara Safari | Tree-Climbing Lions | Glad Of Africa
metaDescription: Explore Lake Manyara National Park: forest, flamingos and tree-climbing lions. Easy add-on to any northern Tanzania safari from Arusha.
